parts.name: back_cushion_swing_porch_person
sources: A box cushion of 148 by 40 by 8 cm: its cover sewn from 5 pieces (World.Sewing.Cushion).
Porch swing cushions of 5 ft: 59 in long, 4 to 5 in thick (Lowe's; Porch Swing Company: the seat is 55 to 60 in wide inside).
A cover of solution-dyed fabric for cushions, 8.00 oz per square yard (271 g/m2: the furniture grade of Sunbrella, Outdoor Fabrics).
A core of polyurethane foam for outdoor cushions, 1.8 lb/ft3 (28.8 kg/m3, Foam Order: outdoor foam).
